Name: Additional Generators
Author: Omegasis
Description:
This mod adds two new items, a biofuel generator, and a geothermal generator that are used to create battery packs.

The Biofuel Generator takes in one of the following items in the specified quantities to produce a battery pack and takes six in-game hours in order to do so.
[list=1]
[*]Coal (3)
[*]Seaweed (5)
[*]Green Algae (5)
[*]White Algae (5)
[*]Fiber (25)
[*]Moss (5)
[*]Slime (50)

[/list]The recipe to craft it can be obtained by [spoiler]buying it from Robin's shop for 10,000g[/spoiler]

The Geothermal Generator works differently in that it can only be placed in specific locations in order for it to work such the 100th floor of the mines in the mountains, [spoiler]or at the top of the Caldera.[/spoiler] It generates battery packs every seven in-game days as long as it is in one of the valid game locations. 

Geothermal Generator placement WARNING:
[spoiler] Although it should make sense to place a geothermal generator at the entrance of the Volcano Dungeon when you first enter, you should not do this. The game clears all objects from that game location at the beginning of every day, so any generators placed here would be removed from the game as well as any other objects. [/spoiler]

The recipe to craft it can be obtained by [spoiler]buying it from the volcano dungeon shop for 20,000g[/spoiler]
